contacts.name: Ava Fatah gen Schieck
contacts.role: Professor of Media Architecture and Urban Digital Interaction; Architectural Space & Computation programme director
contacts.evidence: UCL identifies her media-architecture role and lists her among doctoral supervisors.
contacts.possible_contribution: Strong bridge between interaction design and spatial experience; could turn mixed human/proxy participation into a programme of architectural experiments.
contacts.first_ask: Would a project on delegated presence, reception thresholds and rooms of deliberation fit your doctoral research, and what empirical study would make it compelling?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Listed among current Architectural Space & Computation and Architecture & Digital Theory supervisors.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity, funding, entry qualifications and willingness to advise externally are unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Jüri Soolep
contacts.role: Head of architecture and urban planning doctoral programme
contacts.evidence: EKA publishes his programme role and research on architectural representation in the digital age.
contacts.possible_contribution: Local doctoral anchor for defining delegated presence as an architectural condition and finding an appropriate supervisory team.
contacts.first_ask: Could The Architecture of Presence fit EKA architecture doctoral research, and which supervisor combination and degree background would it require?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Named on EKA's architecture PhD supervisor page.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity, next admission round, funding and eligibility for the applicant's actual qualifications need confirmation.

contacts.name: Kerstin Sailer
contacts.role: Professor in the Sociology of Architecture
contacts.evidence: Studies work practices and building layouts using space syntax, social network analysis and evidence-based design; profile includes research-degree supervision.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could make the social permeability map defensible by connecting spatial configuration, interactions and organisational routines.
contacts.first_ask: How would you design a study of which layouts support encounters when routine transactions are increasingly delegated?
contacts.supervision_evidence: UCL profile advertises research-degree supervision; listed on the Bartlett doctoral supervisor roster.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity, funded opportunities and balance between quantitative and qualitative methods are unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Maroš Krivý
contacts.role: Professor and Director of Urban Studies
contacts.evidence: Researches design, power and knowledge, including cybernetic urbanism.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could challenge whose intent gets encoded into buildings and cities, and prevent the governance strand from treating social conflict as a technical optimisation problem.
contacts.first_ask: Would you critique the societal-harness proposition, particularly how buildings represent contested collective intentions?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Named on EKA's architecture PhD supervisor page.
contacts.unknowns: Supervision capacity and interest in the project's prospective rather than historical orientation are unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Klaske Havik
contacts.institution: TU Delft, Architecture and the Built Environment
contacts.role: Professor of Methods of Analysis and Imagination
contacts.evidence: Develops architectural research on experience and imagination of place through literary and situated methods; contact is published in a 2025 TU Delft book.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could help fieldwork, film and spatial narratives explain the value of physical presence, and support a qualitative architectural method.
contacts.first_ask: Could observation, film and spatial narratives form a rigorous design-research method for chosen presence, and would this fit your research group?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Professor and architectural researcher; this pass did not verify individual recruitment availability or an applicable supervisor roster.
contacts.unknowns: Current PhD capacity, funded route, and use of film as a research output need discussion.

contacts.name: Panu Lehtovuori
contacts.role: Professor of Planning Theory
contacts.evidence: Researches public urban space and new urban design approaches; previously Professor of Urban Studies at EKA.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could anchor the encounter-mapping strand in public-space theory and connect a Tallinn field study with Nordic urban research.
contacts.first_ask: Could the social permeability map become an architecture doctoral project, and how would you distinguish encounter quality from footfall?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Official Tampere project page identifies him as supervisor; EKA also names him on its PhD supervisor list.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity, degree route, external-advisor arrangement and funding are unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Ruth Conroy Dalton
contacts.role: Professor of Architecture
contacts.evidence: Research covers spatial cognition, navigation, space syntax and architectural experience.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could validate the relationship between built form, encounter opportunities, wayfinding and humane experience, including the proposed serendipity routes.
contacts.first_ask: Would encounter mapping and comparisons of physical/proxy participation fit your research area, and which outcome measures would you recommend?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Official profile explicitly welcomes applications from potential PhD students in her research area.
contacts.unknowns: An invitation to inquire does not establish a funded vacancy or acceptance of this topic.

contacts.name: Sam Conrad Joyce
contacts.institution: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
contacts.role: Associate Professor; Architecture and Sustainable Design PhD coordinator; Spatial AI Studio leader
contacts.evidence: Leads Meta Design Lab on cities, computation and human-machine collaboration; published lab contact was surfaced in search.
contacts.possible_contribution: Strong Asia-Pacific route for designing and evaluating spaces, interfaces and permissions for human and autonomous-agent cooperation.
contacts.first_ask: Could mixed human/proxy thresholds be framed as spatial AI research within ASD, and is there a suitable supervisory and funding route?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Official biography identifies him as ASD PhD coordinator.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity and funding are unconfirmed; lab contact was search-readable but the direct lab-page fetch failed.

contacts.name: Antti Ahlava
contacts.role: Professor of Emergent Design Methodologies
contacts.evidence: Research includes urban and building design, Human Cities, and collaborative visualisation of future public space.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could anchor a design-led dissertation in architectural methods and test how chosen presence reorganises public rooms and urban environments.
contacts.first_ask: Would chosen presence under AI delegation fit emergent design methodologies, and what design experiment would establish an architectural contribution?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Listed as a supervising professor for Aalto's Architecture, Landscape and Urbanism doctoral field.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity, funding and expectations for architectural design work are unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Pia Fricker
contacts.role: Professor; Vice Head of Department; Augmented Computational Design
contacts.evidence: Research includes data-driven urban landscapes and immersive collaborative mixed-reality environments.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could help prototype participation across physical and digital environments while keeping the work grounded in architecture and urbanism.
contacts.first_ask: Could hybrid rooms of deliberation and place-specific permissions fit your computational and immersive-design research?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Listed as a supervising professor in Aalto's architecture doctoral field; research portal also records PhD supervision.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity, funding and the fit beyond landscape-focused research are unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Renee Puusepp
contacts.role: Senior Researcher; Head of Research
contacts.evidence: EKA's supervisor biography records a doctorate on agent-based architectural modelling and work with programmable design tools.
contacts.possible_contribution: Local technical partner for simulations and prototypes; could help distinguish modelling occupants from agents that actually act on a person's behalf.
contacts.first_ask: Could you help scope a prototype of permission-aware thresholds or circulation, and assess whether that could form part of an EKA dissertation?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Named on EKA's architecture PhD supervisor page.
contacts.unknowns: Current work emphasises construction systems; interest in inhabited space and delegated agency needs confirmation.

contacts.name: Sophia Psarra
contacts.role: Professor of Architecture and Spatial Design
contacts.evidence: UCL describes spatial modelling combined with empirical user activity to study social, cultural and organisational performance.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could connect assembly, spatial visibility and patterns of participation to architectural layout; particularly relevant to civic and deliberative rooms.
contacts.first_ask: How could a room's configuration make represented participation legible while supporting embodied deliberation?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Listed among current Architectural Space & Computation doctoral supervisors.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity is unconfirmed; current profile was reachable but text extraction was empty, so use the institutional profile/department route rather than a guessed email.

contacts.name: Andres Sevtsuk
contacts.institution: MIT, DUSP and Department of Architecture
contacts.role: Charles and Ann Spaulding Associate Professor of Urban Science and Planning; City Form Lab lead
contacts.category: Potential doctoral supervisor or external advisor
contacts.evidence: Research concerns walking, urban ground floors and amenity patterns; developed Urban Network Analysis tools.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could make encounter-route mapping spatially rigorous and help separate opportunities to meet from actual meaningful encounters.
contacts.first_ask: What would distinguish a social-encounter network from an accessibility or pedestrian-flow model, and could your lab advise on a pilot?
contacts.supervision_evidence: EKA lists him among architecture PhD supervisors; the applicable MIT degree/supervision route was not checked.
contacts.unknowns: MIT recruitment, cross-institutional appointment, capacity and funding are unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Mario Carpo
contacts.role: Reyner Banham Professor of Architectural History and Theory; Architecture & Digital Theory programme director
contacts.category: Potential doctoral supervisor or external advisor
contacts.evidence: Works on architecture, media and computation; published AI Tectonics in 2025.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could situate delegated action within architectural digital culture and sharpen the thesis's originality relative to AI-assisted design.
contacts.first_ask: Does delegated presence identify a distinct architectural shift, and which historical/theoretical framework would best establish that claim?
contacts.supervision_evidence: UCL lists him as Architecture & Digital Theory programme director and supervisor; EKA also lists him.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity and fit with a predominantly empirical/design-based dissertation are unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Mette Ramsgaard Thomsen
contacts.role: Professor of Architecture and Digital Technologies; Head of CITA
contacts.category: Potential doctoral supervisor or research host
contacts.evidence: Combines computation, material systems and architectural demonstrators in research.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could advise on full-scale demonstrators and research through architectural experimentation if the project develops a substantial built prototype.
contacts.first_ask: What would a credible architectural demonstrator for human/proxy thresholds look like, and could it fit a CITA research collaboration?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Professor leading a research centre; individual doctoral recruitment and supervisor eligibility for this proposal were not verified.
contacts.unknowns: Current emphasis is bio-based materials and ecological systems; delegated presence is an inferred methodological connection.

contacts.name: Roland Snooks
contacts.role: Professor of Architecture; Architecture Tectonic Formation Lab director
contacts.evidence: Researches algorithmic design and multi-agent formation; official profile shows current PhD projects.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could support a computational or practice-research route if architectural prototyping becomes the main contribution.
contacts.first_ask: Could a practice-research PhD investigate autonomous agency in inhabited space rather than only algorithmic form generation?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Official RMIT profile explicitly lists openness to Masters Research or PhD supervision.
contacts.unknowns: Form-generating multi-agent algorithms differ from delegated social agents; topical fit and funding remain unconfirmed.

contacts.name: Antoine Picon
contacts.role: Professor of the History of Architecture and Technology; Director of Doctoral Programs
contacts.category: Potential doctoral supervisor or external advisor
contacts.evidence: Studies relations between architectural/urban space, technology and society; directs doctoral programmes.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could challenge and contextualise the broader claim that proxy agency alters architectural presence and urban institutions.
contacts.first_ask: How should a project on delegated presence be positioned within the history and theory of architectural technology, and which doctoral format would fit?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Official Harvard profile identifies his doctoral leadership; EKA includes him on its supervisor page.
contacts.unknowns: Harvard PhD versus DDes fit, capacity and funded admission are unconfirmed; use the profile's published contact link.

contacts.name: Mohan Rajesh Elara
contacts.institution: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
contacts.role: Professor, Engineering Product Development
contacts.evidence: Works on autonomous systems, robot ergonomics and reconfigurable robotics; co-founded Lionsbot.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could test whether proposed proxy entrances, handoff zones and human-priority areas match real robot requirements and operational constraints.
contacts.first_ask: Could your team review the operational assumptions behind a robot-compatible threshold and circulation prototype?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Engineering professor with robotics research; architecture co-supervision or an external appointment was not verified.
contacts.unknowns: This is a technical-advisor lead; any formal role needs agreement from the architecture programme.

contacts.name: Jenni Reuter
contacts.role: Professor of Architectural Principles and Theory; Head of Department
contacts.evidence: Her portfolio includes built architectural work and an Architecture and Film contribution; Aalto lists her departmental leadership.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could protect the humane, sensory and socially attentive architectural ambition and introduce an appropriate Aalto supervisory arrangement.
contacts.first_ask: Could you critique the chosen-presence proposition and advise who at Aalto should supervise a design/fieldwork dissertation in this area?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Not named on the current architecture supervising-professor list; Aalto records an earlier thesis-advisor role.
contacts.unknowns: Do not assume primary-supervisor eligibility; advisor appointment and capacity need confirmation.

contacts.name: Sille Pihlak
contacts.role: Dean of the Faculty of Architecture; PAKK research-group co-lead
contacts.evidence: EKA identifies her dean role; PAKK identifies her leadership in algorithmic timber architecture.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could help position the project within EKA, find prototype facilities and connect architecture with computational research.
contacts.first_ask: Which EKA research context could host experiments on rooms and thresholds for mixed human/proxy participation?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Academic/research leadership is verified; an individual architecture PhD supervisor listing was not established in this pass.
contacts.unknowns: Do not assume primary-supervisor eligibility or available resources; current work is mainly timber and computational construction.

contacts.name: Toomas Tammis
contacts.role: Professor of Architectural Design
contacts.evidence: EKA lists him as Professor of Architectural Design and master's thesis supervisor.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could critique whether the project produces an architectural contribution in plans, sections, rooms and thresholds.
contacts.first_ask: What spatial design experiment would make the Architecture of Presence proposition architecturally convincing?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Master's supervision is published; individual PhD-supervisor status was not established in this pass.
contacts.unknowns: Formal doctoral role, capacity and project interest need confirmation.

contacts.name: Usman Haque
contacts.role: Architect-trained designer and studio co-founder
contacts.evidence: Works in interactive architecture and participatory urban systems; HAQUE TAN develops an assembly with AI-mediated representation.
contacts.possible_contribution: Very close practice connection to rooms of deliberation and represented agency; could share lessons from real participatory prototypes.
contacts.first_ask: Could you discuss what your assembly experiments reveal about space, representation, authority and the limits of AI proxies?
contacts.supervision_evidence: No formal doctoral supervision role identified.
contacts.unknowns: Project access, collaboration and advising availability are unconfirmed; approach the studio jointly with Ling Tan.

contacts.name: Ling Tan
contacts.role: Architect-trained designer, artist and creative technologist; studio co-founder
contacts.evidence: Her practice combines citizen participation, urban data and collective agency; studio works on AI-mediated assembly.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could strengthen participatory evaluation: how people negotiate representation and control, and what an installation actually lets them do.
contacts.first_ask: How would you involve participants in designing and evaluating a room where AI proxies represent absent interests?
contacts.supervision_evidence: No formal doctoral supervision role identified.
contacts.unknowns: Approach jointly with Usman Haque through one studio inquiry, avoiding duplicate requests.

contacts.name: Indy Johar
contacts.role: Co-founder of Dark Matter Labs
contacts.evidence: Dark Matter Labs researches and prototypes institutional infrastructure; its team and publication pages identify Johar.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could help turn governance of autonomous action into institutional and spatial design questions, and challenge how mandates persist over time.
contacts.first_ask: Could the societal-harness idea become a testable institutional/spatial prototype, and where do questions of rights and collective control belong?
contacts.supervision_evidence: No formal doctoral supervision role identified.
contacts.unknowns: Capacity and collaboration are unconfirmed; the verified current route is the organisation's general contact.

contacts.name: Antti Nousjoki
contacts.role: Architect and ALA partner
contacts.evidence: ALA credits him among the partners on Helsinki Central Library Oodi and publishes his office address.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could provide a concrete civic-space case for why people choose to linger, gather and encounter one another when services can also be accessed remotely.
contacts.first_ask: Could you discuss which design decisions at Oodi support chosen presence and suggest an appropriate route to a field study?
contacts.supervision_evidence: No formal doctoral supervision role identified.
contacts.unknowns: Architect advice does not confer permission to observe/film users or access operational data; site research requires the operator's agreement.

project_context.description: Architecture of Delegated Presence: equitable absence/access and a bounded civic-building threshold pilot, with ordinary booking, fixed automation and human-assistance comparisons.
The Architecture of Presence: delegated presence, chosen presence and humane architecture.
Research questions, typologies, fieldwork/film/prototype methods and expected dissertation outputs.
Spatial conditions supporting stranger encounters and a proposed behavioural observation map.
Architecture as part of governance: permissions, circulation, handoffs and collective intent.
